decisions.reason: The combined shuttering/de-shuttering robot is a flagship of the publicly announced automation strategy with heavy sunk R&D, so management persists and attributes weak orders to the temporary construction downturn.
Although the combined robot partly overlaps it, the de-shuttering robot remains a visible core module of automated plant offerings and an earlier commitment management feels bound to justify.
The automatic shuttering robot is central to the future-ready precast automation narrative, and long customer investment cycles let management treat slow uptake as temporary.
This newly launched multi-model product line represents a fresh, sizable investment and public commitment, so it is far too early to abandon it.
The production analysis software is new, cheap to maintain, and supports the digital, lifecycle-oriented direction the firm has announced.
